comment: Lookup table of allowed course delivery types (e.g. Online, In Person), driving selectable values in the GUI rather than a hardcoded list.

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Stable, short machine-readable code for this course type (e.g. IN_PERSON), used directly as the primary key since it's already the natural identifier -- a separate surrogate id would just be a second, unused key alongside it.

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Human-readable label shown in the GUI for this course type.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Determines display order in GUI lists (e.g. a dropdown), independent of code or alphabetical order.

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: Whether this course type is currently selectable for new courses. A deactivated type stays valid for any existing row still referencing it; it just stops being offered as a choice for new ones.
